placements.title: Saving an artifact silently deputizes its own author as its reviewer
placements.frame: When a save/creation action automatically enrolls the creator into a review or oversight role for their own artifact, does that enrollment preserve independent review, or does it quietly collapse the separation between authoring and reviewing?
placements.why: src-1 states a specific, named system rule — saving a memory automatically enrolls its creator as a reviewer — verified by an e2e suite. This is a design/policy behavior (who gets review authority and how) rather than a one-time measurement; it is the kind of subject later envelopes about review workflows, reviewer assignment, or self-review risk would keep feeding. No existing strata or leaf structure exists yet to hold it (both supplied structures are empty), so it stands as a fresh, standalone mint with nothing close enough to draw a lineage edge to.
